content.text:
The sandbox gateway now has the bridge callback URL set to `https://care-abdm-m2.rithviknishad.dev`. It accepted the change (202), and reading it back returns the new URL.

Callbacks to this URL may not reach Django yet, for two reasons:
- **Missing path prefix:** ABDM adds its callback paths straight after the bridge URL, but Django serves them under `/abdm/api/v3/...` ([config/urls.py](care/config/urls.py#L67-L71)). The old URL ended in `/api/abdm`. With just the host, callbacks will 404 unless your proxy rewrites them to `/abdm`. If it doesn't, the URL should probably be `https://care-abdm-m2.rithviknishad.dev/abdm`.
- **Host not answering:** a test request to the new host hung without any response, so the tunnel or DNS may not be live yet.

I didn't change `ABDM_CALLBACK_BASE_URL` in `.envrc`; it still holds its previous value.
